key_insights: Tony Pasquariello's weekly note (7 Nov 2026) is a pointer to a discussion with George Lee, co-head of Goldman Sachs Global Institute, in the annual check-in on the AI theme. The note carries no figures, calls or levels of its own; the content sits behind a Marquee link.
Topics the discussion covers per the note: the setup for the AI theme after the midterms, the financing required behind capex growth, non-traditional ROIC frameworks, and the global AI race.
geopolitical: The note lists a 'global AI race' as a discussion topic, with no detail in the text.
